# opencode-notify

OpenCode plugin that sends Windows system notifications and plays notification sounds when OpenCode needs permission, requests input, or finishes a session.

## Requirements

- OpenCode V2 (2.1.2 or newer)
- Windows or WSL
- Bun for local development

Notifications are only sent when the plugin is running on Windows or WSL. Other platforms load the plugin but skip desktop notifications.

## Install

```sh
npm install @remvn/opencode-notify
```

## Usage

Add the plugin to your OpenCode config:

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugins": ["@remvn/opencode-notify"],
}
```

For local development, run `bun install` and configure the package directory instead of a file. OpenCode loads the TypeScript source directly; no build is required:

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugins": ["/absolute/path/to/opencode-notify"],
}
```

This version uses the V2 plugin API and does not support OpenCode V1.

## Behavior

- Sends a notification when a root session becomes idle.
- Sends a notification when permission is requested.
- Sends a notification when a form requests input, including from child sessions.
- Plays Windows notification sounds for supported events.
- Deduplicates near-simultaneous permission notifications.
- Stops its event subscription and in-flight notification process when unloaded or reloaded.

## Development

Install dependencies:

```sh
bun install
```

Run type checks:

```sh
bun run lint
```

Build the package:

```sh
bun run build
```

Run automated plugin tests (Node.js required; no Windows desktop required):

```sh
bun run test
```

Use `bun run notify-test` on Windows or WSL to manually test a desktop notification.

Preview the npm package contents:

```sh
npm pack --dry-run
```
